incumbency_hold_policy: The other 37 lack a unique federal-service person bridge. A different member in the same district and absent name matches do not alone establish nonincumbency. Preserve these holds.
qualification_policy: Qualify literal factual observations separately from completed-attainment coding, paid employment, election-day timing, and contrast estimability. Source status alone neither qualifies nor rejects a claim. Retrospective acquisition remains prospectively ineligible.
negative_history_review: No explicit never-served responses were found in held Democratic military, prior-office or government-history fields. Blank questionnaire fields and candidate-did-not-provide responses are not negatives.

rejected_matches.reason: Ray Pooley's voter guide says work/military information was not provided; this is not nonservice.
Opelika's Lee McInnis assistant-city-engineer record lacks a bridge to the AL-03 candidate whose held source reports a communications background. Do not merge a same-name government employee.
A partisan commentary's assertion of no previous office is not a candidate questionnaire or sufficient primary evidence; AmeriCorps is not military service.
